newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi relaxes curfew restrictions in capital.
newsitem.headline: Burundi relaxes curfew restrictions in capital.

text.p: The curfew in the Burundi capital Bujumbura has been cut by two hours, Burundi radio announced.
It said on Saturday that the curfew would now start at midnight instead of 10 p.m.

The radio gave no reason for the relaxation, but the situation in Bujumbura was calm although tension remained in surrounding areas where clashes have recently taken place between the army and armed rebels.
Local residents, expecially operators of bars and nightclubs, said they welcomed the relaxation.
